note: Captions use 'text'; the synthetic narrator reads 'say' when given. {placeholders} come from the recorded job (demo/build/app/job.json).

lines.text: FrameGuard Sightline checks rendered and exported video for the frames that slip through review.
It uses OpenCV 5 for the analysis and runs on AWS.
lines.say: It uses OpenCV five for the analysis, and runs on A W S.

lines.text: A delivered video can still contain a black frame, a stalled run of identical frames, one stray frame from another shot, a frame with block damage, or dropped frames.
Each fault lasts a fraction of a second. A tired reviewer misses it, and checking again costs another full viewing.
Sightline gives small studios, animation teams and media labs a first pass they can check.
OpenCV 5 measures every frame, and an agent re-checks each suspicion with the test that fits it.
lines.say: OpenCV five measures every frame, and an agent re-checks each suspicion with the test that fits it.

lines.text: A person decides what happens to the footage, and the agent then verifies the result.
This is the review page, served by API Gateway and Lambda.
lines.say: This is the review page, served by A P I Gateway and Lambda.

lines.text: The reviewer uploads a test clip: the 52-second Sintel trailer with five defects seeded inside moving shots.
lines.say: The reviewer uploads a test clip: the fifty-two-second Sintel trailer, with five defects seeded inside moving shots.

lines.text: The browser sends the file straight to a private S3 bucket with a presigned form, and Step Functions starts the job.
lines.say: The browser sends the file straight to a private S three bucket with a presigned form, and Step Functions starts the job.

lines.text: On a Graviton Lambda, OpenCV 5 decodes each frame once and measures brightness, a perceptual hash, colour histograms, edge density, the block grid and optical flow.
lines.say: On a Graviton Lambda, OpenCV five decodes each frame once, and measures brightness, a perceptual hash, colour histograms, edge density, the block grid, and optical flow.

lines.text: Detectors turn these measurements into candidates, and the agent checks each one again.
After {tool_calls} follow-up checks, the agent reports {defects} defects and {needs_review_phrase} for review. It dismissed {dismissed} events, such as edits and fades, with a reason for each.
lines.say: After {tool_calls_words} follow-up checks, the agent reports {defects_words} defects and {needs_review_phrase_words} for review. It dismissed {dismissed_words} events, such as edits and fades, with a reason for each.

lines.text: Every finding shows the frames around it and the reason for the verdict.
For this flash, a sharp change of shot started the check. The agent compared the next frames with the shot before it.
The picture returned one frame later, in colour and in layout, so it reports one foreign frame instead of two cuts.
Dismissed items stay listed with their reasons, so the reviewer can overrule them.
The frame skip is marked for review because its motion only partly matches the shot.
Nothing changes until the reviewer approves.
Sending the decisions resumes the workflow, which has been waiting on a Step Functions task token.
The black, flash and damaged frames are patched in a preview by holding the nearest good frame of the same shot.
The stall and the skip cannot be rebuilt from an export, so they go to a re-render list.
Then the agent analyses its own repair. None of the repaired ranges is flagged again.
The whole stack is one CloudFormation template in a free-plan AWS account.
lines.say: The whole stack is one CloudFormation template, in a free-plan A W S account.

lines.text: S3 holds uploads and reports and deletes them after seven days, and DynamoDB keeps the job state.
lines.say: S three holds uploads and reports and deletes them after seven days, and Dynamo D B keeps the job state.

lines.text: Step Functions runs analyse, wait for a person, then act. The OpenCV Lambda runs on Graviton, the HTTP API is rate-limited, and CloudWatch records metrics without image content.
lines.say: Step Functions runs: analyse, wait for a person, then act. The OpenCV Lambda runs on Graviton, the H T T P A P I is rate-limited, and CloudWatch records metrics without image content.

lines.text: The agent is a bounded controller, not a language model.
It owns five checks and a budget of 60 checks and 1,200 re-decoded frames per job.
lines.say: It owns five checks, and a budget of sixty checks and twelve hundred re-decoded frames per job.

lines.text: Every check is logged with its trigger, its measurements and its decision, and whatever the budget cannot cover goes to a person.
Thresholds were fixed on development clips before the test sets were generated.
On 24 synthetic test clips, Sightline found 88 of 93 seeded defects with no false positives.
lines.say: On twenty-four synthetic test clips, Sightline found eighty-eight of ninety-three seeded defects, with no false positives.

lines.text: On real trailers with seeded defects, it found 14 of 18, with about one false positive per 1,000 frames.
lines.say: On real trailers with seeded defects, it found fourteen of eighteen, with about one false positive per thousand frames.

lines.text: The unmodified trailers produced no defect findings.
Frame skips are the weakest class on real footage: one of three was found.
A dark flash is reported as a black frame, and repairs are previews, not re-renders.
Sightline inspects picture integrity only. It does not detect or identify people, and uploads expire after seven days.
The code, the technical report and the evaluation are linked from the submission.
